adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateTopicEmbeds` uses `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true`, which will drop an existing `topic_embeds` table if it somehow already exists (e.g., a partially applied/hand-created table or a rerun outside normal Rails migration guards), risking data loss. However, from the diff alone this is a brand-new table (no prior `topic_embeds` exists here), and Rails migrations are not normally “re-run” without rollback, so this is more a migration-safety/best-practice concern than a verifiable defect introduced by the PR. Also, the claim that it makes the `change` non-reversible is not clearly supported by the diff, since `create_table` is generally reversible.
